engines.name: Living Atlas / UI
engines.role: Human-facing experiences, rooms, navigation and controls
engines.evidence: Public core README and private UI project completion map; route-level current checks remain necessary.
limits: A route existing in source does not prove it is deployed or functional.

engines.name: Mirror Cartographer Network
engines.role: Owner-scoped identity, shared-world services and provenance API
engines.evidence: MirrorNetworkClient and documented provenance API actions; production availability not verified in this review.
limits: Bearer token required.
No silent synchronization.
Only explicitly approved records may be synchronized.

engines.name: LYR
engines.role: Language and symbolic interpretation with provider routing
engines.evidence: tools/ask.mjs supports local Ollama and compatible remote providers, optional local retrieval and optional Network retrieval.
limits: No verified trained LYR checkpoint.
CLI bridge is not the website conversation runtime.
Provider calls may incur separate charges.

engines.name: FREE 2.0
engines.role: Proposal registration, consequence mapping, integrity gates and human-review decisions
limits: Not an ethics oracle.
Cannot authorize high-impact decisions.
Requires accountable human review.

engines.name: Mirror Engine
engines.role: Evidence records, links, contradictions and model-output receipts
limits: SQLite store is not encrypted at rest.
Do not store sensitive personal data.
Network synchronization is a separate explicit operation.

engines.name: Relationship Engine
engines.role: Rank candidate structural bridges for human inspection
limits: Candidate topology is not proof of causation.
Not a general autonomous ARC service.

engines.name: Human Judgment Lab
engines.role: Rubric design, calibration, reliability and evaluation operations
engines.evidence: J README, recovery index, evaluation program and Consensus Trap experiment.
limits: Synthetic results are not field evidence.
No empirical human-rater study is established.
Agreement is not validity.

engines.name: Compute Mesh
engines.role: Bounded workers, node identity, signed manifests/receipts and resource limits
engines.evidence: Private-workspace implementation; prior local report recorded 14/14 tests passing.
limits: Enrollment, multi-device communication, recovery and production deployment remain incomplete.

engines.name: Neurology Research Engine
engines.role: Local evidence-aware neurological research provenance workflow
limits: Research instrument, not a diagnostic or treatment system.
No clinical integration or validation established.

engines.name: Business Value Engine
engines.role: Discover valuable problems, compose engine capabilities into deliverables, validate outcomes, model delivery economics and guide reinvestment
engines.evidence: Historical Tech Growth Strategy recovery and Engine Mesh business lifecycle; no executable opportunity or pricing engine is established.
limits: A proposed opportunity is not customer demand.
No revenue or willingness-to-pay claim without buyer validation.
Do not monetize private records or sensitive inferences.

routing_rules: Route by declared capability and explicit user purpose.
Check permissions and data classification before retrieving or transmitting inputs.
Pass the smallest required payload; prefer provenance references over raw archives.
Preserve engine identity, version, limitations and review state in every result.
Store model outputs as unreviewed until an authorized human reviews them.
Require FREE review and authorized human decision-making for consequential proposals.
Use Human Judgment Lab evaluation independently; engines must not self-certify their own quality.
Fail closed when an adapter, permission, credential, schema or resource limit is missing.
